name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits, introducing Connect Knowledge for read-only cloud drive integration (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), and per-room agent Channels. Notable security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salting and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 with 238 commits, v0.6.0 followed shortly after
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — password-based auth with PBKDF2 hashing, per-install salt, rate-limiting, and reverse proxy support

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links resolve via a marker-scan parser but the canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update mechanism to a new location; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases rather than the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is significantly heavier to self-host and configure.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more enterprise-grade document management experience with workflows and permissions, but requires more resources and setup than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document processing and metadata extraction but has a steeper learning curve and heavier stack compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is a lightweight file manager supporting many storage backends, but it lacks document-specific features like OCR and tagging that Cabinet focuses on.

alternatives.name: Mayan EDMS
alternatives.review: Mayan EDMS is a full-featured enterprise document management system with extensive workflow support, but it is considerably more complex and resource-intensive than Cabinet.
